changeSummary: Zero Trust runtime decision prompt in the v20 dictionary format (W3-1 to W3-19, TO-1 to TO-5, LU-1 to LU-4, R4-T, R4-B9 and the P3 extra work; the 2026.10.14-v20.14 manifest lists them), with the P4 system text: the minimum action rules P1 to P3 the host turned on, in place of the elevated-risk boundary (W4-4); the boundaries and evidence rules on prompt facts only, resource classes in the ResourceClass words and no fresh-verification fact (N-RULE-1); the output contract v3 block with the meaning and the cited line of every reason code (W4-2); no fixed reason sentences, the decision keeps the model's reason (W4-3). With structured output the provider schema carries the code meanings; the schema text for a provider without it does not (dictionary 4, 5). The budget profiles fitted to these prompts the TO-5 way.
